findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tape_leaderboard · Private data: tape_market_pulse, tape_markets_radar, tape_leaderboard, tape_wallet_analysis, tape_liquidations, tape_liquidation_heatmap · Public sink: tape_liquidation_heatmap, tape_treasury_curve.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tape_leaderboard · Private data: tape_market_pulse, tape_markets_radar, tape_leaderboard, tape_wallet_analysis, tape_liquidations, tape_liquidation_heatmap · Public sink: tape_liquidation_heatmap, tape_treasury_curve

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "tape_market_signals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
